method_name: PLACE-inspired ViT progressive channel dropout for CoRP
preserved_official_semantics: one randomly selected candidate layer per training step
corp_adaptations: CNN feature map [B,C,H,W] is mapped to ViT block output [B,C,views,tokens]
the mask is shared across three views and all CLS/patch tokens
four ViT blocks 2,5,8,11 replace ResNet stages
official integer stage-2 epoch is mapped to equivalent_epoch = reference_epochs * step / total_steps with reference_epochs 30
fixed-random control uses the same layers, budget and recovery with constant p=0.33

scope_boundary.reason: DomainDrop random includes domain discriminator, GRL, domain loss and consistency; PLACE fixed-random does not
